items.title: Polish deputy defence minister warns against severing ties with Russia
items.summary: Deputy Defence Minister Stanisław Wziątek warned in a radio interview that breaking diplomatic relations with Russia could create a risk of war. His remarks followed Poland's summoning of the Russian ambassador over an alleged airspace violation.

items.title: US travel advisory warns against visiting Ukraine
items.summary: Reports citing an updated US State Department advisory say Ukraine remains at Level 4, the highest travel warning, citing the risk of missile and drone attacks throughout the country.

items.title: Russian-appointed Luhansk officials announce additional school generators
items.summary: The Russian-appointed regional education minister said around 600 generators had already been supplied to educational institutions and more than 100 additional units were planned before year-end.

items.title: Russian-appointed Donetsk mayor reports overnight damage
items.summary: The mayor said an alleged Ukrainian drone attack damaged a residential building's roof and destroyed eight vehicles. The account has not been independently verified.
